```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

dir_image <- here::here("results/image-interpretation/")
dir_baseline <- here::here("results/plot-baseline")
dir_image_matched <- here::here("results/image-interpretation-matched/")
dir_blank <- here::here("results/plot-blank/")
dir_baseline_memo_prompt <- here::here("results/plot-baseline-prompt-memo")
dir_baseline_thinking <- here::here("results/plot-baseline-thinking")
dir_baseline_mitm <- here::here("results/plot-baseline-mitm")

bind_results <- function(dir) {
  fs::dir_map(dir, read_rds, type = "file") |>
    purrr::list_rbind() |>
    mutate(
      score = fct_recode(
        score,
        "Correct" = "C",
        "Incorrect" = "I"
      )
    )
}

image_only <- bind_results(dir_image)
baseline <- bind_results(dir_baseline)
image_only_matched <- bind_results(dir_image_matched)
blank <- bind_results(dir_blank)

baseline_memo_prompt <- bind_results(dir_baseline_memo_prompt)
baseline_thinking <- bind_results(dir_baseline_thinking)
baseline_mitm <- bind_results(dir_baseline_mitm)
```

```{r setup-bluffbench}
bluffbench_mitm <-
  read_rds("results/bluffbench-mitm/sonnet.rds") |>
  mutate(intervention = "Model-in-the-middle")

bluffbench_memo_prompt <-
  read_rds("results/bluffbench-prompt-memo/sonnet.rds") |>
  mutate(intervention = "Memo prompt")

bluffbench_thinking <-
  read_rds(
    "results/bluffbench-thinking/tsk_claude_4_5_sonnet_thinking.rds"
  )$get_samples() |>
  mutate(
    intervention = "Thinking",
    model = "claude_4_5_sonnet"
  ) |>
  select(id, epoch, score, intervention, type, model)

bluffbench <-
  bind_rows(
    bluffbench_memo_prompt,
    bluffbench_thinking,
    bluffbench::bluff_results |> mutate(intervention = "None")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    score = fct_recode(
      score,
      "Correct" = "C",
      "Incorrect" = "I"
    )
  ) |>
  bind_rows(bluffbench_mitm)
```

```{r theme-setup}
theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)
```

```{r plot-helpers}
plot_heatmap <- function(data, facet_var) {
  data |>
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(epoch), y = id, fill = score)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(vars({{ facet_var }}), ncol = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Correct" = "#67a9cf", "Incorrect" = "#ef8a62")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Epoch",
      y = "Sample",
      fill = "Score"
    )
}
```

## Model writes code, then interprets plot

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Overall
```{r plot-overall}
baseline |>
  ggplot(aes(y = model, fill = score)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = rev,
    values = c("Correct" = "#67a9cf", "Incorrect" = "#ef8a62")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent",
    y = "Model",
    title = "Baseline plot interpretation",
    subtitle = "Model writes plotting code then interprets plot"
  )
```

### By sample

```{r}
baseline |>
  mutate(model = fct_rev(model)) |>
  plot_heatmap(model)
```

### By prompt

```{r}
baseline |>
  filter(model == "sonnet-4.5") |>
  mutate(prompt = "Generic") |>
  bind_rows(baseline_memo_prompt |> mutate(prompt = "Memo")) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = prompt, fill = score)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = rev,
    values = c("Correct" = "#67a9cf", "Incorrect" = "#ef8a62")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent",
    y = "Prompt",
    title = "Prompt comparison on baseline task - Sonnet 4.5"
  )
```

:::

## Comparing interventions - Claude Sonnet 4.5

```{r assemble-baseline}
baseline_comparison <-
  bind_rows(
    baseline |> mutate(intervention = "None"),
    baseline_memo_prompt |> mutate(intervention = "Memo prompt"),
    baseline_thinking |> mutate(intervention = "Thinking"),
    baseline_mitm |> mutate(intervention = "Model-in-the-middle")
  ) |>
  filter(stringr::str_detect(model, "[Ss]onnet")) |>
  mutate(type = "baseline")

intervention_comparison <-
  bluffbench |>
  filter(
    type != "baseline",
    stringr::str_detect(model, "[Ss]onnet")
  ) |>
  bind_rows(baseline_comparison) |>
  mutate(
    intervention = fct_relevel(
      intervention,
      "Model-in-the-middle",
      "Thinking",
      "Memo prompt",
      "None"
    )
  )
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### By intervention and task

```{r}
intervention_comparison |>
  ggplot(aes(y = intervention, fill = score)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(vars(type)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = rev,
    values = c("Correct" = "#67a9cf", "Incorrect" = "#ef8a62")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent",
    y = "Intervention",
    title = "Intervention comparison",
    subtitle = "For bluffbench and baseline (code+image) tasks"
  )
```

### Heatmap - mocked only

```{r}
intervention_comparison |>
  filter(type == "mocked", intervention != "None") |>
  plot_heatmap(intervention)
```

### Memo prompt

Your primary job is to accurately interpret visualizations. 

When evaluating a visualization, first analyze the plot as if you had no prior knowledge about the data and subject matter. Ignore the axis labels during this process, only describing the visual elements of the plot. Emit in \<MEMO\>\</MEMO\> tags what you see during this process. 

Afterwards, you may incorporate knowledge about the data or contextual knowledge, but make sure to accurately report and incorporate what you noted in the prior tags, even if it contradicts your prior or contextual knowledge. 

:::

## MITM - closer look

```{r mitm}
mitm <-
  read_rds(
    "results/bluffbench-mitm/mitm_evaluation_results.rds"
  ) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  mutate(epoch = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(id, score = grade, epoch, target, answer = mitm_full) |>
  left_join(bluffbench::bluff_results |> distinct(id, type), by = "id") |>
  mutate(
    score = fct_recode(
      score,
      "Correct" = "C",
      "Incorrect" = "I"
    )
  )
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## MITM vs. primary model

```{r}
mitm |>
  filter(type != "baseline") |>
  group_by(type) |>
  summarize(score = sum(score == "Correct") / n()) |>
  mutate(model = "MITM") |>
  bind_rows(
    bluffbench |>
      filter(
        str_detect(model, "[Ss]onnet"),
        intervention == "Model-in-the-middle",
        type != "baseline"
      ) |>
      group_by(type) |>
      summarize(score = sum(score == "Correct") / n()) |>
      mutate(model = "Primary")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = model, x = score)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#67a9cf") +
  facet_wrap(vars(type)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Percent",
    y = "Model",
    title = "MITM is far more accurate than primary model"
  )
```

## By sample

```{r mitm-heatmap}
mitm |>
  group_by(id) |>
  slice_head(n = 3) |>
  filter(type == "mocked") |>
  plot_heatmap("Mocked")
```
